about_short_description.short_description: Khoj is the open-source, AI second brain. Get answers from your notes, documents, and the internet.

product.name: Khoj AI Research Copilot
product.description: An AI tool that assists users in understanding documents, answering questions, and creating content by integrating information from notes, documents, and the internet.

product.name: Customizable Specialist AI Agents
product.description: Tailored AI agents that provide recommendations and assistance based on specific professional or personal domains, adjustable to user preferences.

product.name: Autonomous Task Delegation and Notifications
product.description: A service that automates repetitive tasks by delivering tailored research, event-based notifications, and custom newsletters directly to users.

product.name: Multimodal Query and Visualization Interface
product.description: An interface enabling users to ask complex questions across documents and the internet, with support for voice interaction and visual content generation.

product.name: Transparency and Explainability Features
product.description: Tools that provide insight into the AI's reasoning process, enabling users to verify sources and understand how responses are generated.

product.name: Integration with Multiple AI Models
product.description: Capability to bootstrap the AI system using various commercial and open-source AI models from providers like Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, and HuggingFace.
